items.title: Add per-step identity-keyed checkpoint list to the autopilot run record schema
items.context: phase+stepIndex+command+sha256(inputs) -> status pending|done|failed plus dispatchId/evidence ref; persisted atomically after each step (append-then-fsync), never a positional count. Files: handlers/lattice-autopilot.ts AutopilotRunRecord, core/autopilot-executor.ts per-step write.

items.title: Rewrite autopilot_resume to skip done checkpoints and resume at the first non-done step
items.context: handlers/lattice-autopilot.ts:1179-1203 currently always returns status:refused. Load record -> recompute planned steps -> skip steps whose identity-keyed checkpoint is done -> resume at first non-done. Resume only at step boundaries.

items.title: RED tests: resume touches each completed step once, void-tail no-duplicate, no-refuse-on-healthy
items.context: Kill mid-phase then resume (per-checkpoint run count == 1); inject a void step between completed steps and assert only the void re-runs (the 21-duplicate regression ported); autopilot_resume no longer refuses a healthy non-stale record.
